influences.name: David Bowie
influences.context: From a young age, he was drawn to the world of music and found solace in the sounds of artists like David Bowie, T. Rex, and Marc Bolan. These influences would later shape his unique vocal style and androgynous image.

influences.name: Malcolm McLaren
influences.context: He narrates the brief yet significant period linked to Malcolm McLaren's engagement with Bow. Emphasizing McLaren's unique method of crafting and presenting songs. The encounter compelled Boy George to cultivate a unique artistic perspective and to question the conventional norms of the industry.
